decision.summary: Retain production defaults: tested alternatives show no robust CPU/frame benefit that justifies increased payload and protocol bytes.
decision.scope: Benchmark-only indexed lossless-PNG settings; no quantization, codec-selection, requested-quality or high-color/ARGB Cairo policy change.

measurement: Same immutable private.10 native library, real display planner/workers/PNG encoder/serialization to a shared discard socket, varying benchmark-only indexed compression settings.
aggregation: Each table entry is the arithmetic mean of the two per-run summaries for its mode. Changes are ratios of these means. p95 values are not pooled percentiles, and no cross-workload desktop score is computed. Protocol bytes include serialization; PNG payload bytes are observed before base64.

provenance.exploratory_note: Exploratory driver was a working-tree snapshot identified only by raw harness SHA-256, predating mixed-Cairo scope guards. It is not claimed to be frozen Git source. These records omit wrapper hashes. Their helper/header bytes match the final committed helper/header hashes.
provenance.final_note: Finalized driver/wrapper/helper/header hashes exactly match the final study commit and release implementation. All library subjects remain the private.10 image; this is a compression-policy study, not a private.10/private.11 encoder-speed comparison.

validation.independent_rgb_note: Each run separately replays two untimed lossless frames per case and compares every expected canvas RGB pixel. Execution/pixel totals include repetitions of the same synthetic fixtures; timed frames are not individually decoded here.
validation.replay_override_scope: The original codec/quality overrides are bypassed in forced-lossless replay; the PNG compression hook remains active for indexed PNGs selected by that original path. This is not an individual decode check of every timed PNG payload; the separate 24-configuration PNG regression matrix exercises direct encoder settings.

limitations: Synthetic, unpaced, three text workloads; no capture, RDP transport, Wi-Fi, physical input or browser in these native timing records.
Different PNG compression settings intentionally change encoded bytes while preserving decoded pixels; these runs do not prove byte-identical output across settings.
Hook-off/default controls expose instrumentation plus execution-order/cache/scheduling variation; noisy p95 differences cannot be subtracted as a deterministic overhead correction.
Exploratory and finalized driver timings have different observation work and must not be compared as a direct implementation delta. Each internal comparison uses one driver on both modes.
Exploratory mixed-Cairo enforcement was absent, but every observed PNG in the enabled text cases was indexed; hook-off controls retain identical PNG work/bytes with the enabled default side.
Final confirmations alternate candidate/baseline/candidate/baseline; equal repeat counts do not remove all order effects.

Regression raw metadata pins image/revision and success/settings coverage but does not itself pin runner/helper file hashes. The supporting committed hashes are recorded separately, not presented as execution-time metadata.
Paced browser delivery and final native classifier/release comparisons are separate release artifacts, not inferred from discard-socket timing.

raw.measurement: production display planner, copy search, FIFO, workers, codecs and serialization to a shared discard socket
raw.limitations: synthetic fixtures; no capture, RDP transport, browser, Wi-Fi, physical input or frame pacing; copied pixels/planner/encoding included, fixture generation excluded
raw.fixture_note: original nine scenarios preserved; added all-solid, zero-copy-hit, early/late exact-copy-hit and alternating-size planner-reuse fixtures
raw.policy_note: baseline never calls the setter and preserves its shipped policy (including private.6 default12); adaptive passes setter value1, enabling the candidate default12 rather than limiting it to one worker; only values greater than1 override the adaptive cap; fixed passes0 as a separate full-pool diagnostic; test_active_cap is the legacy setter-control value, not necessarily an observed worker count
raw.verification: separate untimed strict ASCII protocol replay with real PNG/lossless WebP decoding and exact RGB comparison of every fixture pixel after each checked frame; timing/RSS captured before verification; opaque fixed-size fixtures only, not a general browser or alpha/resize validator

png_compression_study.scope: benchmark-only png_write_png interposition for indexed images; production defaults and Cairo fallback unchanged
png_compression_study.overhead: enabled builds add header-prefix coverage, thread-local and relaxed numeric counter work per image; compare off/default to measure overhead; no PNG control helper linked when off

raw.statistics_note: planner counter deltas cover measured frames only; scratch bytes are retained-capacity gauges; unavailable baseline counters are null, not zero
raw.planning_phase_timing_note: existing numeric TRACE phase durations captured without formatting; per-frame mean/p95 use integer-millisecond wall times; search includes both candidate indexing and copy search; zero phase durations are valid; phase quantiles cannot be subtracted from full-frame quantiles

encoder_control.method: benchmark-only ELF symbol interposition: auto forwards the original selector, fixed mode replaces only its decision, encoders always forward to the image's real implementations; hook coverage verified for every image; forced-lossless correctness replay disables overrides

controlled_workload_comparison.fields: codec calls, geometry, actual image pixels, quality range, WebP lossless mode; encoded bytes/fingerprints stay strict except PNG across explicitly different study settings

encoded_fingerprints.method: per-image FNV-1a64 over concatenated encoded bytes before base64, aggregated as unsigned sum and XOR per codec independent of completion order; non-cryptographic integrity evidence alongside pixel replay, not a security proof
encoded_fingerprints.timing_note: enabled runs add per-byte hashing and must be excluded from headline performance comparisons; no encoded payloads retained or printed

raw.encoder_timing_note: summed per-image encoder wrapper wall times include codec work plus streaming/serialization/socket waits; concurrent sums are not frame latency or standalone codec CPU; instrumentation is identical on old/new libraries

render_diagnostics.note: optional numeric telemetry adds clocks only in supporting libraries; use separate diagnostic runs when an older baseline cannot collect it; microsecond cumulative measured-frame deltas, maxima include initialization/warmup; overlapping phase sums and quantiles are not additive; no network-delivery timing

validation.hook_off_note: Off baselines have no indexed counters; paired enabled default controls have identical work and PNG payload bytes.

raw.encoder_timing_note: summed per-image encoder wrapper wall times include codec work plus streaming/serialization/socket waits; concurrent sums are not frame latency or standalone codec CPU; instrumentation is identical on old/new libraries

render_diagnostics.note: optional numeric telemetry adds clocks only in supporting libraries; use separate diagnostic runs when an older baseline cannot collect it; microsecond cumulative measured-frame deltas, maxima include initialization/warmup; overlapping phase sums and quantiles are not additive; no network-delivery timing

validation.hook_off_note: Off baselines have no indexed counters; paired enabled default controls have identical work and PNG payload bytes.

raw.measurement: production display planner, copy search, FIFO, workers, codecs and serialization to a shared discard socket
raw.limitations: synthetic fixtures; no capture, RDP transport, browser, Wi-Fi, physical input or frame pacing; copied pixels/planner/encoding included, fixture generation excluded
raw.fixture_note: original nine scenarios preserved; added all-solid, zero-copy-hit, early/late exact-copy-hit and alternating-size planner-reuse fixtures
raw.policy_note: baseline never calls the setter and preserves its shipped policy (including private.6 default12); adaptive passes setter value1, enabling the candidate default12 rather than limiting it to one worker; only values greater than1 override the adaptive cap; fixed passes0 as a separate full-pool diagnostic; test_active_cap is the legacy setter-control value, not necessarily an observed worker count
raw.verification: separate untimed strict ASCII protocol replay with real PNG/lossless WebP decoding and exact RGB comparison of every fixture pixel after each checked frame; timing/RSS captured before verification; opaque fixed-size fixtures only, not a general browser or alpha/resize validator

png_compression_study.scope: benchmark-only png_write_png interposition for indexed images; production defaults and Cairo fallback unchanged
png_compression_study.overhead: enabled builds add header-prefix coverage, thread-local and relaxed numeric counter work per image; compare off/default to measure overhead; no PNG control helper linked when off

raw.statistics_note: planner counter deltas cover measured frames only; scratch bytes are retained-capacity gauges; unavailable baseline counters are null, not zero
